evaluations.evidence: search and discover music using content identification or fingerprinting
evaluations.rationale: No other story prohibits or contradicts fingerprint-based search; other discovery methods are complementary.

evaluations.evidence: search and discover music based on my profile
evaluations.rationale: Profile-based discovery is compatible with other discovery approaches; no conflicting constraints stated elsewhere.

evaluations.evidence: based on other users similar to myself
evaluations.rationale: Collaborative filtering does not conflict with profile-based or fingerprint-based discovery; no exclusivity is specified.

evaluations.evidence: music or ringback tones similar to a given music video based on content similarity
evaluations.rationale: Content-similarity search is additive to other search modes; no story states such search must not exist.

evaluations.evidence: exploiting enriched metadata and image tags
evaluations.rationale: Metadata/tag-based discovery aligns with tagging and identification stories; no contradictory rules appear.

evaluations.evidence: upload tagged videos and have tags available for all further processing steps
evaluations.rationale: Making tags available supports later filtering/annotation stories; no story requires tags to be unavailable or restricted.

evaluations.evidence: view thumbnail sequences of video segments
evaluations.rationale: Viewing thumbnails does not contradict any other behavior or permission in the backlog.

evaluations.evidence: get info about similar video items and segments
evaluations.rationale: Similarity info is consistent with other recommendation/similarity stories; no incompatible requirement is stated.

evaluations.evidence: get info about perceptually similar video items and segments
evaluations.rationale: Perceptual similarity is a refinement of similarity and does not conflict with ZO-008 or others.

evaluations.evidence: receive content recommendations from similar profiles
evaluations.rationale: Recommendation source (similar profiles) is compatible with other recommendation criteria (e.g., news events).

evaluations.evidence: recommendations based on most relevant news events in my area
evaluations.rationale: Location/news-based recommendations can coexist with profile-based recommendations; no mutual exclusion is specified.

evaluations.evidence: identify persons in videos, and receive related information
evaluations.rationale: Person identification does not contradict product/brand/logo identification; they can all be supported together.

evaluations.evidence: identify products in videos
evaluations.rationale: Product identification is compatible with other identification features; no conflicting constraints exist.

evaluations.evidence: identify broadcaster logos in videos
evaluations.rationale: Logo identification is consistent with other recognition tasks; no story forbids it.

evaluations.evidence: identify brands in videos
evaluations.rationale: Brand identification complements product/logo/person identification; no incompatible rule is stated.

evaluations.evidence: take a picture or upload an image ... recommended with videos related to that picture
evaluations.rationale: Image-based recommendation does not conflict with other recommendation/search mechanisms.

evaluations.evidence: access content using a geographical map and be informed if there are videos covering the area
evaluations.rationale: Map-based access is compatible with other discovery and recommendation stories; no contradictory access restriction is stated.

evaluations.evidence: search content items using automatic speech recognition
evaluations.rationale: ASR-based search is another search modality and does not conflict with other search requirements.

evaluations.evidence: As an admin, I want to see, validate and edit segmentation of videos.
evaluations.rationale: Admin editing/validation of segmentation is consistent with admin annotation and filtering stories; no story disallows admin edits.

evaluations.evidence: annotate news video segments and extract a topic for each segment
evaluations.rationale: Annotation and topic extraction aligns with segmentation management and filtering; no incompatible requirement is present.

evaluations.evidence: filter and rank videos based on A/V quality aspects
evaluations.rationale: Quality-based ranking does not contradict other filtering/prefiltering stories; multiple filters can coexist.

evaluations.evidence: quick assessment of whether audio material has been edited before the upload
evaluations.rationale: Assessing prior edits is compatible with later noise removal and other processing; no story forbids edited audio.

evaluations.evidence: prefilter nudity content
evaluations.rationale: Nudity prefiltering is not contradicted by any story requiring nudity content to be allowed or unfiltered.

evaluations.evidence: prefilter content using search based on low­level asset information
evaluations.rationale: Low-level prefiltering is compatible with high-level prefiltering and other admin filters; no incompatibility stated.

evaluations.evidence: validated the ingested contents for copyright infringement
evaluations.rationale: Copyright validation does not conflict with upload/tagging or discovery stories; no story mandates allowing infringing content.

evaluations.evidence: prefilter ... high­level asset information such as metadata and tags ... recognized by the system or provided by the user
evaluations.rationale: High-level prefiltering complements low-level prefiltering and tagging availability; no contradictory rule exists.

evaluations.evidence: assess how interesting or appealing or complex a picture is based on automated analysis, citizen annotations, and comments on Talk
evaluations.rationale: Interest/complexity assessment is consistent with other admin analytics and prompting/interrupting logic; no conflicting requirement stated.

evaluations.evidence: detect when a scientist should be prompted to look at a subject
evaluations.rationale: Prompting scientists based on annotations/comments does not contradict other admin decision-support stories.

evaluations.evidence: identify volunteer types
evaluations.rationale: Volunteer typing supports weighting/interrupt/education recommendations and does not conflict with them.

evaluations.evidence: preclassify the Galaxy Zoo images using simple low­level image features
evaluations.rationale: Galaxy Zoo preclassification is domain-specific and does not conflict with other project-specific preclassification stories.

evaluations.evidence: detect Snapshot Serengeti images with no classifiable animals
evaluations.rationale: Detecting empty/unclassifiable images is compatible with subsequent species/attribute/number preclassification.

evaluations.evidence: automatic image series detection ... timestamping malfunction
evaluations.rationale: Series detection for timestamp issues does not contradict other Snapshot Serengeti automation stories.

evaluations.evidence: automatic animal species preclassification in Snapshot Serengeti
evaluations.rationale: Species preclassification is consistent with attribute and number detection; no incompatible rule is stated.

evaluations.evidence: automatic animal attribute preclassification in Snapshot Serengeti
evaluations.rationale: Attribute preclassification complements species and number detection; no contradictions present.

evaluations.evidence: automatic animal number detection in Snapshot Serengeti
evaluations.rationale: Number detection is compatible with species/attribute preclassification and empty-image detection.

evaluations.evidence: automatic segmentation or localization of plankton in Plankton Portal
evaluations.rationale: Segmentation/localization supports later size/orientation/species detection and does not conflict with them.

evaluations.evidence: detect Plankton Portal images with no classifiable plankton
evaluations.rationale: Empty/unclassifiable detection is compatible with segmentation and species/size detection for classifiable images.

evaluations.evidence: automatic detection of plankton size or orientation
evaluations.rationale: Size/orientation detection complements segmentation and species preclassification; no incompatible constraints stated.

evaluations.evidence: automatic preclassification of plankton species
evaluations.rationale: Species preclassification is consistent with segmentation and size/orientation detection; no conflicts indicated.

evaluations.evidence: worm motion analysis to reduce video duration
evaluations.rationale: Reducing duration via motion analysis does not contradict detecting egg-laying time; both can be derived from the same video.

evaluations.evidence: detect the time ... where the worm lays an egg
evaluations.rationale: Egg-laying time detection is compatible with motion analysis and does not impose contradictory constraints.

evaluations.evidence: detect important features such as areas of flooding, damage, temporary shelters, blocked roads
evaluations.rationale: Satellite feature detection is standalone and does not conflict with other image/audio/video processing stories.

evaluations.evidence: assess the probability/weight of a volunteer’s classification based on their experience
evaluations.rationale: Weighting classifications by experience supports volunteer typing and interruption/education decisions; no contradictory rule exists.

evaluations.evidence: prefiltering of the images to remove artefacts such as bright stars and camera read errors
evaluations.rationale: Artefact removal is compatible with moving/transient object detection; no story requires keeping artefacts.

evaluations.evidence: detect moving and transient objects in the images
evaluations.rationale: Object detection can coexist with artefact removal; the backlog does not state incompatible processing order or constraints.

evaluations.evidence: remove background noise and distracting sounds from the audio files
evaluations.rationale: Noise removal does not conflict with assessing whether audio was edited; both can be performed.

evaluations.evidence: group whale calls that are similar
evaluations.rationale: Grouping similar calls is compatible with counting whales heard; no contradictory rule is stated.

evaluations.evidence: identify the number of whales heard in a single audio file
evaluations.rationale: Counting whales can leverage similarity grouping and does not conflict with it.

evaluations.evidence: know when I should interrupt a volunteer
evaluations.rationale: Interruption decisioning is compatible with deciding interruption modality and education decisions; no story forbids interruptions.

evaluations.evidence: interrupt a volunteer with text, an image, or a video
evaluations.rationale: Choosing interruption modality complements (does not contradict) deciding when to interrupt.

evaluations.evidence: know when I should educate a volunteer
evaluations.rationale: Education decisioning is compatible with deciding education modality and content; no conflicting rule exists.

evaluations.evidence: educate a volunteer with text, an image, or a video
evaluations.rationale: Choosing education modality complements deciding when to educate; no incompatibility stated.

evaluations.evidence: know which piece of education I should give to a volunteer
evaluations.rationale: Selecting education content is consistent with education timing and modality stories; no contradictory constraints appear.

evaluations.evidence: know when a volunteer has made an interesting comment on a subject
evaluations.rationale: Detecting interesting comments is compatible with Zoonibot commenting/explaining; no conflicting behavior specified.

evaluations.evidence: know when Zoonibot should comment on a subject
evaluations.rationale: Bot-comment timing is compatible with detecting interesting comments and deciding explanations/wording.

evaluations.evidence: know when Zoonibot should give an explanation
evaluations.rationale: Bot explanation timing complements bot commenting and message content selection; no contradictions stated.

evaluations.evidence: know what Zoonibot should say to a volunteer
evaluations.rationale: Message content selection is compatible with deciding when to comment/explain; no conflicting rules appear.

evaluations.evidence: group subjects by similarity
evaluations.rationale: Subject similarity grouping does not contradict any other story; it can support recommendations and prompting.

evaluations.evidence: recommend different projects to volunteers based on their previous experiences
evaluations.rationale: Project recommendation is compatible with volunteer typing and other recommendation mechanisms; no exclusivity stated.

evaluations.evidence: see a summary of articles, so that I reuse them
evaluations.rationale: Article summarization/reuse does not impose constraints that contradict any other story in the backlog.
